title: Exact parameter accounting, configuration validation and the budget solver (NF-1T)
note: NA1-NA20: the counts a 1T claim rests on -- off by one, shared or tied or buffer parameters mis-counted, all experts counted as active, a routing profile's top_k ignored -- and the configuration and solver refusals that keep an illegal or out-of-range architecture from being named.

mutations.name: NA1_total_off_by_one
mutations.rationale: one parameter more than the tensors hold

mutations.name: NA2_shared_active_omitted
mutations.find: shared_active = sum(v for cat, v in act.items() if cat != "expert")
mutations.rationale: the always-active computation left out of the active count

mutations.name: NA3_tied_parameter_double_counted
mutations.replace:
c["reconstruction_head"] = vf * d + 1
        tied = vf * d
mutations.rationale: a tied decoder counted again under its own head

mutations.name: NA4_all_experts_counted_active
mutations.rationale: every expert reported as active per token

mutations.name: NA5_profile_top_k_ignored
mutations.rationale: every routing profile reports the standard active count

mutations.name: NA6_router_bias_invented
mutations.replace: c["router"] = moe_layers * d * e + moe_layers * e
mutations.rationale: a router bias counted that no tensor holds

mutations.name: NA7_buffers_counted_trainable
mutations.rationale: normalisation buffers counted as trainable parameters

mutations.name: NA8_whole_embedding_table_active
mutations.rationale: a token credited with every identity row instead of its own

mutations.name: NA9_kv_heads_ignored
mutations.find: per_attn = d * inner + 2 * d * kv + inner * d
mutations.rationale: grouped-query attention counted as full multi-head

mutations.name: NA10_kv_heads_need_not_divide
mutations.find:
if self.num_kv_heads > self.num_heads \
                or self.num_heads % self.num_kv_heads:
mutations.rationale: a kv-head count that does not divide the heads accepted

mutations.name: NA11_top_k_above_experts
mutations.rationale: top_k one larger than the expert count accepted

mutations.name: NA12_head_dims_not_checked
mutations.rationale: an attention width that is not the hidden size accepted

mutations.name: NA13_fp8_build_accepted
mutations.rationale: a model built in unvalidated FP8

mutations.name: NA14_router_precision_not_enforced
mutations.rationale: routing decided in reduced precision

mutations.name: NA15_solver_takes_the_wider_width
mutations.find: f = min(candidates, key=lambda x: (abs(total_at(x) - target.total), x))
mutations.rationale: the solver no longer takes the nearest total

mutations.name: NA16_solver_range_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a configuration outside its range returned as a solution

mutations.name: NA17_active_at_or_above_total_accepted
mutations.rationale: an active target equal to the total is not a mixture

mutations.name: NA18_solve_record_digest_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a solve record whose configuration was edited is trusted

mutations.name: NA19_bf16_bytes_wrong
mutations.rationale: bfloat16 parameter storage reported at four bytes

mutations.name: NA20_training_flops_understated
mutations.rationale: training FLOPs without the second backward matmul
